messages:
maria (Product PM): Quick sync — streaming-routing went GA last week and we surfaced stability/UX issues. Need a plan for the next two sprints: how much capacity goes to immediate bug fixes vs follow-on enhancements from customers. Can we align by EOD?

alex (Eng): I pulled crash logs. Summary: 4 P0/P1 crashes, ~11 P2s. Top P0 is an NPE during cold-start batch. Minimal repro: intermittent on small sample. Patch estimate: ~2 dev-days. Other P1s are OOMs under very long sequences (~16k tokens).

vika (SRE): OOMs spike in us-west correlating with a small subset of clients sending long contexts. We've enabled a soft request size limit + 429 fallback for affected routes. Added alert: streaming-routing/oom-rate > 0.5% -> page.

jordan (CS): EnterpriseA reports ~5% of their requests see errors; they're calling this a blocker for rolling to full prod. They're asking for a faster patch (within 2 weeks).

ben (Design): UX: when retries trigger we sometimes render duplicate tokens in the client. It's noisy but non-breaking. Fix would be design + 1 eng half-sprint; estimate ~3 working days.

sam (PM): Proposal: Sprint N+1 focus on P0/P1 hotfixes (NPE + top OOM mitigation) and a canary rollout. Sprint N+2 we do remaining stability work + UX polish + prioritized customer asks. If EnterpriseA is unwilling to wait, escalate to a hotpatch plan.

maria (Product PM): Suggest micro-triage: allocate 40% capacity to hotfixes (sprint N+1) and 60% to high-impact enhancements (sprint N+2). Approve? @alex @vika

alex (Eng): 40/60 OK with current estimates. Need to codify rollback threshold: if OOM error-rate > 1% we auto-roll back model variant.

vika (SRE): Agreed on rollback threshold. Recommend canary in us-west at 5% traffic first, with faster alerting. I'll set dashboards and runbooks.

jordan (CS): I'll check with EnterpriseA on whether 2 weeks is acceptable. If not, I'll flag immediate escalation. Will update this thread by EOD.

maria (Product PM): Action items (short):
- alex: ship NPE patch + run canary (ETA 3d)
- vika: enable 5% canary in us-west + wire dashboards/alerts (ETA 1d)
- ben: design spec for retry dedupe UX (ETA 4d)
- jordan: customer commitment check with EnterpriseA (ETA EOD)
- sam: schedule sprint capacity and update roadmap + release notes (ETA tomorrow)

ops-bot: Deploy started: canary/streaming-routing v1.0.5 -> us-west (5%)

alex (Eng): Patch pushed to branch. Need one quick reviewer for the NPE guard change — @maria or @sam?

maria (Product PM): I can review tonight after sync. :thumbsup:

vika (SRE): Canary monitoring live. Lowered alert thresholds for the canary and added a temporary synthetic test hitting long-sequence path. (reaction :eyes:)

jordan (CS): EnterpriseA replied — they can tolerate a 10-day window if we provide daily status and a customer-facing note. I'll need a 2-paragraph summary they can share.

sam (PM): I'll draft the customer-facing status note and post to #customer-commms; will cc @jordan for approval.

maria (Product PM): Good. Reconvene after canary completes (or earlier if alerts). Go/no-go rule: if canary error-rate > 0.2% we halt and roll back. Otherwise proceed to broader rollout and schedule N+2 enhancements. Post canary results in this thread — no meeting unless there's a spike.

ben (Design): Noted. I'll share a quick Figma spec and attach the before/after screenshots to this thread in ~4d.

alex (Eng): Thanks team, starting work now.

ops-bot: Canary completed: canary/streaming-routing v1.0.5 -> us-west snapshot 24h. Summary: error-rate 0.12%, OOM rate 0.14%. No P0s observed in canary window.

maria (Product PM): Canary results look within thresholds. Plan: rollout to 25% tomorrow morning, monitor 6h, then full roll if stable. Closing the triage — updated roadmap and tickets will reflect the 40/60 split.
